dialect.detail: IBM mainframe COBOL; converted by COBOL Conversion Aid PO 5785-ABJ on 02/12/96; VMOD=2.004; uses VSAM INDEXED files, SORT-FILE with SYS-device assignments, COMP-3, EJECT directives, and fixed-format line numbering typical of IBM OS/VS COBOL or VS COBOL II
evidence: ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED / ACCESS IS DYNAMIC

purpose.domain_detail: Pending net premium reporting by general agent and state for WDS (likely a Workers' Disability/Compensation or similar insurance system); authored by Logic, Inc., Dallas, Texas
purpose.summary: This batch program reads VSAM indexed files (policy/account/company databases) and produces pending net premium reports sorted and grouped by general agent and state. It generates printed output and disk output with page headers, subtotals, and grand totals.

notable_features: VSAM INDEXED files with ALTERNATE KEY
Multiple COPY statements for FD definitions
FILE STATUS fields for VSAM error handling
Year 2000 compliance review noted in comments
COBOL Conversion Aid migration history documented
